evidence.claim: WHO reported that a 17-member Ethiopian emergency medical team was deployed to Gode in June 2022, screened 211 children, and admitted about 100 children with severe acute malnutrition to treatment.
evidence.title: Ethiopian Emergency Medical Teams' first deployment provides support to drought-affected areas
evidence.excerpt: WHO reported that a 17-member Ethiopian emergency medical team was deployed to Gode in June 2022, screened 211 children, and admitted about 100 children with severe acute malnutrition to treatment.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct operational report with concrete caseload and implementation details.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributed to Ethiopian health authorities under the Abiy Ahmed government, with WHO training and coordination.
contrary_evidence: It is a localized emergency response and not proof of systemwide service quality.
It reflects the severity of the underlying drought crisis.

evidence.claim: WFP said more than 20 million people in Ethiopia were facing hunger, that 19 months of war had left more than 13 million in need of food assistance in the north, and that humanitarian supplies were flowing after the government's humanitarian truce.
evidence.title: Conflict, climate and soaring food prices push Ethiopia further into hunger while WFP funding runs out
evidence.excerpt: WFP said more than 20 million people in Ethiopia were facing hunger, that 19 months of war had left more than 13 million in need of food assistance in the north, and that humanitarian supplies were flowing after the government's humanitarian truce.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct contemporaneous WFP emergency reporting with explicit statistics and a government-truce linkage.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributed partly to the Abiy Ahmed government's truce-enabled access policy, but mostly reflects inherited conflict and climate shocks.
contrary_evidence: The source also shows the scale of deprivation and aid dependence.
Aid flow was not uniform and fuel constraints persisted.

evidence.claim: WFP, UNHCR and Ethiopia's Refugees and Returnees Service appealed for funds to keep feeding over 750,000 refugees after ration cuts and warned that vulnerable families faced undernutrition and increased protection risks.
evidence.title: WFP, UNHCR, RRS appeal for funding to continue feeding over 750,000 refugees in Ethiopia
evidence.excerpt: WFP, UNHCR and Ethiopia's Refugees and Returnees Service appealed for funds to keep feeding over 750,000 refugees after ration cuts and warned that vulnerable families faced undernutrition and increased protection risks.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct joint appeal with explicit numbers and Ethiopia government participation through RRS.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributed to the Abiy Ahmed government only indirectly through the state refugee service; the main driver was funding shortfall and displacement pressure.
contrary_evidence: This is more a sign of unmet need than successful welfare provision.
The source shows donor dependence and ration cuts.

evidence.claim: UNICEF said EU funding would restore education services and implement school feeding in conflict-affected areas, noting that nearly two million children were out of school due to conflict and that over 8,500 schools in conflict-affected regions had been damaged or destroyed.
evidence.title: EU donates €33 million (1.8 billion ETB) to UNICEF and WFP to restore essential education services and implement school feeding programmes in conflict-affected areas in Ethiopia
evidence.excerpt: UNICEF said EU funding would restore education services and implement school feeding in conflict-affected areas, noting that nearly two million children were out of school due to conflict and that over 8,500 schools in conflict-affected regions had been damaged or destroyed.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct Ethiopia-specific joint funding announcement with explicit scale of educational disruption and restoration plan.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributed to the Abiy Ahmed government's conflict-affected education environment; implementation was partner-led.
contrary_evidence: The source is mainly about repair and recovery from conflict damage.
The funding is external rather than a demonstration of domestic fiscal capacity.
